summary: FOUR BEDROOM FAMILY HOME Spacious four bedroom semi-detached property located close to the centre of Bishop Auckland and close to links to Darlington & Barnard Castle. The property is within easy walking distance to local amenities such as Aldi, Tesco, Sainsburys & Restaurants. The accommodation comprises of Large Kitchen, Two Large Reception Rooms, Four Bedrooms, Family Bathroom with Shower, Fully Double Glazed, Gas Central Heating, Garden to Rear. Property Excludes all Utilities and also Council Tax.
